title: Fix ProfileEditFormDialog's doc comment claiming profile mode is not editable on edit

evidence.quote:
/// Mode is shown but not editable on edit (matching the existing Manage
/// Learners behaviour — only name + avatar are persisted).

// PP-2 fix: pass result.mode so that the selected mode (child/adult) is
    // actually persisted. Previously mode was silently dropped...

why: The class doc comment on ProfileEditFormDialog says mode is 'shown but not editable on edit', but its SegmentedButton is fully interactive (onSelectionChanged sets state) and editProfileFlow explicitly persists `result.mode` via repo.updateProfile — a documented bugfix (PP-2) three lines below the call site. A maintainer trusting the stale comment could miss that changing a child's mode to adult also has a load-bearing side effect a few lines later (clearing that profile's stored PINs).
recommendation: Update the doc comment to state mode IS editable and persisted, and cross-reference the PIN-clearing side effect in editProfileFlow.
acceptance_criteria: Doc comment on ProfileEditFormDialog accurately describes current (editable) mode behavior
